items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well you know Rene had taken Simon too. Yeah. Simon Moreira.

ctx.x: I remember Joe started with the clarinet for that. Because he had no son and Rene and it was strange. Yeah. Yeah. And uh uh the old man Rene uh uh Guernie was playing bass with him first. See. Mmhmm. With Rene. He started with Rene. After that he they had a fallen out and then that's where they take me. And uh after I had broke up with him then they take him to Chester. Is that Chester's artist? Chester's artist. They took him on the bass and they had uh him and Rene had to run in again then he come back and got…

Well you know Rene had taken Simon too. Yeah. Simon Moreira. When you had a Bitskin band came in. Huh? When you had a Bitskin band came in. What band? Bitskin. Yeah. You know a Zuta band you call it. Oh you're talking about uh. You're talking about uh.
Something called bazooka sometimes too. Like Bob Burns used to use on radio. That's fun of me. Slowgraf played in one of those.
